# The Elicta Handbook

> This page is written by machine, read straight out of the code each
> time this handbook is produced, so it cannot fall out of date. Editing
> it by hand has no effect — the next build puts it back. It is read
> from `handbook/book.toml`.

Elicta helps you ask the question you would otherwise have missed — while the
client is still in the room — and then writes up what was agreed, quoting the
words that were actually said.

This is a guide to using it. It goes in the order you will meet it: setting it
up, preparing for an engagement, the meeting itself, and what comes out
afterwards. Every screen is shown.

It assumes nothing about how the software is built. Where something is not
finished, it says so plainly rather than describing an intention in the same
voice as a fact.
